instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: B2B SaaS platform for field service management including scheduling, dispatching, mobile work orders, and invoicing. 600+ customers across HVAC, plumbing, and electrical trades. Processing 2 million work orders annually. Current ARR growth rate of 40%. Evaluating AI-powered route optimization and parts inventory prediction modules. A growing organization that has moved past founder-led decision-making but is still building the formal processes and governance structures needed to scale. We have some digital tools in place but integration between systems is ad-hoc. Innovation is championed by 1-2 internal advocates.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have a mature innovation program with a dedicated R&D lab of 12 engineers, an annual innovation budget equivalent to 5% of revenue, and a structured stage-gate process for evaluating and funding new initiatives. In the past 3 years we have launched 4 new product lines that now contribute 18% of total revenue, including an AI-powered recommendation engine that has become our fastest-growing SKU.
answers.strategicGoals: We are targeting a 20% improvement in operational throughput without increasing headcount. Our processes have grown organically over the years and are overdue for standardization. We suspect that workflow digitization, basic automation, and better data integration between our core systems can unlock significant productivity gains within our current cost structure.
answers.teamSize: Our team includes 3 backend developers, 1 frontend developer, and 1 QA engineer, managed by the CTO who also acts as product owner. We outsource UI/UX design to a freelance designer as needed. The team can handle incremental product improvements but struggles to carve out focused time for larger innovation bets without compromising current sprint commitments.

input.changes_since_last: Acquired 4 new enterprise clients. Expanded into adjacent market. Digital maturity improving.

opportunities.title: Implement Cross-Platform Data Governance and Workflow Standardization
opportunities.rationale: The company has mature processes and dedicated resources, but current system integration is ad-hoc. Standardizing the core data model across field service management systems, billing, and inventory will unlock significant efficiency gains required to hit the 20% throughput goal.

first_actions: Establish a Data Governance Working Group involving engineering leads and business stakeholders.
Map current end-to-end critical workflows (e.g., Work Order -> Invoicing) to identify data choke points and required transformations.
Define minimum viable standards for core entities (Customer, Job Site, Service Type) that all systems must adhere to.
execution_plan.success_metric: Completion and sign-off on standardized data dictionary for 3 core business processes.
milestones: Phase 1: Data Mapping & Gap Analysis Complete
Phase 2: Governance Framework Defined and Adopted
Phase 3: Pilot Implementation in one service vertical

opportunities.title: Pilot AI-Powered Parts Inventory Prediction Module Integration
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging the existing R&D capacity and strategic goal of operational improvement, an inventory prediction module can reduce downtime. This must be treated as a compliance-first product rollout given the regulated nature of parts tracking.

first_actions: Review all local/federal safety regulations pertaining to stored medical or specialized service parts (Compliance Check).
Integrate historical work order data (parts used vs. job type) into a dedicated analytics environment.
Develop MVP model focusing solely on the top 10 highest-cost, longest lead-time parts.
resources_needed: Quality Assurance (QA) resources for rigorous testing
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction of Mean Time To Service due to predicted parts availability by 15% in the pilot area.
milestones: Pilot Deployment within the R&D Lab environment

next_steps.action: Establish a formal Data Governance Council (DGC) to mandate data standards and resolve system integration conflicts.
Allocate dedicated 15% 'Deep Work' time within the R&D lab capacity specifically for process standardization and integration tasks, protecting this bandwidth from feature creep.
Formalize the handoff criteria (documentation, QA gate) between product development and compliance/operations teams to ensure scalable feature deployment.

key_weaknesses: System Integration Debt: Core systems still operate with significant ad-hoc data linkages, creating operational risk and limiting automation scope.
Resource Bottlenecking: The CTO/Product Owner role is stretched thin, impeding the focused time needed for enterprise-level process redesign.
Process Adherence Consistency: While processes are formalized (stage-gate), consistency across all 4 new acquired enterprise clients needs continuous auditing to prevent drift.

improvements: Structural Maturity: The formalization of the innovation program, dedicated R&D lab, and stage-gate process represents a massive leap in institutional capacity.
Market Validation: Acquisition of 4 new enterprise clients validates product fit and provides scale necessary to justify major efficiency investments.
persistent_gaps: Cross-System Interoperability: The foundational gap between systems remains, requiring dedicated governance efforts rather than feature development alone.
Dedicated Time Allocation: Sustaining deep work on standardization requires protected executive time that is currently difficult to carve out amidst rapid growth.
achieved_milestones: The innovation process has successfully moved from founder-led decision-making to a structured, repeatable stage-gate model.
Successful expansion into an adjacent market validates the platform's scalability outside of core service lines.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Significant improvement in structural maturity and process formalization (moving from ad-hoc to structured stage-gate). This mitigates previous operational risks but highlights deep system integration debt as the primary barrier to achieving efficiency goals.
